trans-unit.source: Software developer focused primarily on backend development with Java and Spring Boot, complemented by frontend development with Angular and TypeScript. I build solutions with emphasis on maintainability, testing, documentation, and clear engineering decisions.

trans-unit.target: Los proyectos seleccionados demuestran cómo abordo problemas reales de software, decisiones técnicas, implementación, testing, documentación y entrega.

trans-unit.source: Professional bilingual and responsive platform built to present my profile, software projects, technical skills, and engineering decisions. It includes adaptive navigation, light and dark themes, English and Spanish localization, automated testing, technical documentation, CI/CD, and continuous deployment.
trans-unit.target: Plataforma profesional bilingüe y responsive construida para presentar mi perfil, proyectos de software, habilidades técnicas y decisiones de ingeniería. Incluye navegación adaptativa, temas claro y oscuro, localización en inglés y español, testing automatizado, documentación técnica, CI/CD y despliegue continuo.

trans-unit.source: Informational and commercial website developed for a Mexican microenterprise. Built as a responsive landing page with adaptive navigation, a functional contact form using Nodemailer, and serverless deployment on Vercel.
trans-unit.target: Sitio web informativo y comercial desarrollado para una microempresa mexicana. Construido como una landing page responsive con navegación adaptativa, un formulario de contacto funcional mediante Nodemailer y despliegue serverless en Vercel.
